### CVE-2025-0186 — Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling in GitLab
- Assigner: GitLab | Published: 2026-04-22 | Updated: 2026-04-22 | Max CVSS: 6.5
- CWE: CWE-770 CWE-770: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 6.5 MEDIUM `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 10.6 before 18.9.6, 18.10 before 18.10.4, and 18.11 before 18.11.1 that could have allowed an authenticated user to cause denial of service under certain conditions by exhausting server resources by making crafted requests to a discussions endpoint.

**solutions:** Upgrade to versions 18.9.6, 18.10.4, 18.11.1 or above.

Affected:
- GitLab / GitLab: affected 10.6 <18.9.6 (semver); affected 18.10 <18.10.4 (semver); affected 18.11 <18.11.1 (semver)

Credits: Thanks [pwnie](https://hackerone.com/pwnie) for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program

References:
- https://hackerone.com/reports/2915694 [technical-description,exploit,permissions-required]
- https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/511312
- https://about.gitlab.com/releases/2026/04/22/patch-release-gitlab-18-11-1-released/
